dialogues.speaker: Matthaus
dialogues.text: Heh, yeah! I just got back from a business trip to Snezhnaya and brought in a whole batch of the good stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Matthaus
dialogues.text: It's got a strong kick, bold and fiery, but there's this nice hint of citrus and honey underneath...

dialogues.speaker: Matthaus
dialogues.text: Even if you're not much of a drinker, it makes a great gift for friends! Not to mention, they're top-quality stuff, all crafted by the fae in Novokitezhgrad. What do you think? Want to give it a try?
